release_notes_summary: EDR calculation, assumptions, reporting and saved-case updates; experimental off-axis restriction retained.
notes: Clarifies signed EDR delta-v, angular inputs, ignition-cycle assumptions and ignition-date estimates.
Adds an assumption-based precrash speed-at-impact range with separate timing, braking/acceleration, wheel-slip and calibration adjustments.

Adds standalone ground-force delta-v partitioning: net N, ground contribution G, additive adjustment -G, and collision-only C = N - G. Results cover the selected interval, are not statistical confidence intervals or reconstructed impact speeds, and are not automatically transferred to downstream calculators.
Adds experimental off-axis sensor-to-CG delta-v correction with signed synchronized inputs, conditioning, sensitivity and recorded assumptions.
Clarifies quantity, axis and interval requirements in correction workflows, manual correction and EMR, including saved-case and reporting guidance.
Preserves the existing update-download Save As workflow. Automatic installation remains disabled; close the app before manually replacing the portable folder. Preserve your cases and settings.
Experimental — physical validation pending; not qualified for casework use.
This restriction applies to off-axis correction and remains visible in Results, Show Work and exports. Software verification and workbook agreement do not establish physical accuracy.

The public package retains the previously published reference bundle and bibliographic citations for the newer methods. Eighteen internal course/reference files, photographs and review notes are omitted because public redistribution is not established or they are internal development materials. Their calculator citations remain available, but their document copies are not included. Library summary labels do not prove every cited document is locally available; analysts must obtain and review the cited material independently.
